outer_diameter = 38.4
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
total_length = 80.0
shoulder_length = 21.3
main_length = total_length - shoulder_length
inner_diameter = 20.0
chamfer_size = 5.0
fillet_radius = 2.0

main_cyl = Pos(main_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(outer_diameter / 2, main_length)
shoulder_cyl = Pos(main_length + shoulder_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(shoulder_diameter / 2, shoulder_length)
combined = main_cyl + shoulder_cyl

inner_cyl = Pos(total_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_diameter / 2, total_length)
hollow = combined - inner_cyl

chamfer_cone = Pos(total_length - chamfer_size / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cone(shoulder_diameter / 2, (shoulder_diameter / 2) - chamfer_size, chamfer_size)
chamfered = hollow - chamfer_cone

result = fillet(chamfered.edges(), fillet_radius)

part = result
part.name = "stepped_hollow_cylinder"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 38.4
inner_diameter = 20.0
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
total_length = 80.0
shoulder_length = 21.3
base_length = total_length - shoulder_length
fillet_radius = 2.0
chamfer_distance = 2.0
hole_diameter = 6.0
hole_offset = shoulder_length / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, outer_diameter / 2))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (base_length, outer_diameter / 2))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (base_length, shoulder_diameter / 2))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (total_length, shoulder_diameter / 2))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (total_length, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_diameter / 2, total_length)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(total_length / 2, hole_offset, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, total_length)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[0]
solid_body = fillet(bottom_face.edges(), fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

star_outer_radius = 40.0
star_inner_radius = 30.0
star_points = 5
thickness = 21.1
hex_pocket_radius = 20.0
hex_pocket_depth = 15.0
central_hole_radius = 11.2
fillet_radius = 2.0

pts = []
for i in range(2 * star_points):
    angle = i * math.pi / star_points
    r = star_outer_radius if i % 2 == 0 else star_inner_radius
    pts.append((r * math.cos(angle), r * math.sin(angle)))

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Polygon(*pts)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)

with BuildPart() as hp:
    with BuildSketch() as hs:
        RegularPolygon(hex_pocket_radius, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_pocket_depth)
hex_pocket = Pos(0, 0, thickness - hex_pocket_depth) * hp.part
solid_body = solid_body - hex_pocket

hole = Pos(0, 0, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(central_hole_radius, thickness)
solid_body = solid_body - hole

part = solid_body
part.name = "star_with_hex_pocket_and_hole"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
overall_height = 80.0          # Z extent of the revolved body
overall_width  = 57.5          # X extent (outer curved surface)
wall_thickness = 22.2          # Y extent / depth of the curved wall
inner_offset   = 15.0          # inner flat face offset from the revolve axis

# ---- pocket (rectangular cut into the outer curved face) ----
pocket_width  = 12.0
pocket_height = 20.0
pocket_depth  = 5.0

# ---- through hole ----
hole_diameter = 4.0
hole_offset_x = 10.0           # along the width, from the inner face
hole_offset_z = 15.0           # up from the base

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, overall_height))          # inner flat face
            l2 = ThreePointArc(l1 @ 1, (overall_width, overall_height / 2), (0, 0))  # outer curve
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=wall_thickness)                          # revolve profile -> curved wall

solid_body = p.part

# rectangular pocket on the outer curved face (centred on the part)
pocket = Pos(overall_width - pocket_depth / 2, wall_thickness / 2, overall_height / 2) * \
         Box(pocket_depth, pocket_width, pocket_height)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket

# through hole (cylinder along Y, through the full wall thickness)
hole = Pos(hole_offset_x, wall_thickness / 2, hole_offset_z) * \
       Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, wall_thickness + 2)
solid_body = solid_body - hole

part = solid_body
part.name = "revolved_curved_wall_with_pocket_and_hole"
export_step(part, "output.step")

overall_length = 80.0
overall_height = 45.2
thickness = 7.6
leg_width = 12.0
leg_height = 30.0
shoulder_width = 20.0
shoulder_height = 15.2
inner_radius = 10.6
fillet_radius = 0.8
hole_diameter = 5.0
hole_spacing = 30.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (leg_width, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (leg_width, leg_height))
            a1 = ThreePointArc(l2 @ 1, (leg_width + inner_radius, leg_height + inner_radius), (leg_width + shoulder_width, leg_height + shoulder_height))
            l3 = Line(a1 @ 1, (overall_length, leg_height + shoulder_height))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (overall_length, overall_height))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, overall_height))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)

for x, y in [(-hole_spacing/2, 0), (hole_spacing/2, 0)]:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, thickness/2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, thickness)

part = solid_body
part.name = "bracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

overall_length = 80.0
overall_height = 45.2
thickness = 7.6
body_width = 40.0
body_height = 40.0
arm_length = 40.0
arm_thickness = 6.0
bore_radius = 10.6
fillet_radius = 3.0
mount_hole_radius = 3.0
mount_hole_spacing = 30.0
pocket_width = 20.0
pocket_height = 10.0

body = Box(body_width, body_height, thickness)
arm = Pos(body_width/2 + arm_length/2, body_height/2 - arm_thickness/2, 0) * Box(arm_length, arm_thickness, thickness)
result = body + arm

    result = result - Pos(0, y, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_radius, thickness)

pocket = Pos(0, -body_height/2, 0) * Box(pocket_width, pocket_height, thickness)
result = result - pocket

part = result
part.name = "bracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

                (stem_width/2, base_thickness + 20),
                (-stem_width/2, base_thickness + 20),

with BuildPart() as p:

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (long_arm_length, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (long_arm_length, long_arm_width))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (short_arm_width, long_arm_width))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (short_arm_width, short_arm_length + long_arm_width))

import math

overall_length = 80.0
overall_width = 28.3

# ---- raised tab at the right end ----
tab_length = 20.0

# ---- through slot (rounded ends) ----

# ---- through hole in the tab ----

hole_center_x = 70.8               # from left end of main body

# ---- 30 deg chamfer on the leading (left) edge ----
chamfer_len = 7.4
chamfer_angle = 30.0
chamfer_dy = chamfer_len * math.tan(math.radians(chamfer_angle))

# ---- main body (left end trimmed by the 30 deg chamfer) ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(
                (0, 0),
                (overall_length - tab_length, 0),
                (overall_length - tab_length, overall_width),

                (0, chamfer_dy),
                close=True,

        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

from build123d import *

bracket_length = 80.0
bracket_height = 53.3
bracket_depth = 26.7
base_thickness = 8.0
step_height = 18.7
step_length = 50.0
fillet_radius = 2.7

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (bracket_length, 0), (bracket_length, bracket_height),
                     (bracket_length - step_length, bracket_height),
                     (bracket_length - step_length - 4.0, base_thickness),
                     (0, base_thickness), close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_depth)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "bracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

plate_height = 80.0

mount_hole_offset = 28.0
boss_outer_dia = 52.5
boss_inner_dia = 30.0
boss_height = 60.0
boss_chamfer = 1.2

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Rectangle(plate_width, plate_height)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

solid_body = p.part

vertical_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
solid_body = chamfer(vertical_edges, corner_chamfer)

solid_body = solid_body - inner_bore

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
chamfer_edges = top_face.edges() + bottom_face.edges()

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
hub_diameter = 30.5          # 1x ⌀30.5  (central through hole / hub bore)
hub_height = 26.1            # overall height of the part
boss_diameter = 23.4         # ø23.4      (outer cylindrical bosses)
boss_hole_diameter = 18.1    # 5x ⌀18.1   (through holes in the bosses)
boss_circle_radius = 30.35   # 60.7 / 2   (bolt circle of the six bosses)
chamfer_size = 1.0           # small chamfer on the top rim edges

# ---- central hub (solid cylinder, bore cut later) ----
hub = Cylinder(hub_diameter / 2, hub_height)

# ---- six equally spaced outer bosses ----
bosses = None
for i in range(6):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 6)
    px = boss_circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = boss_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    boss = Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(boss_diameter / 2, hub_height)
    bosses = boss if bosses is None else bosses + boss

# ---- union hub + bosses ----
result = hub + bosses

# ---- central through hole ----
result = result - Cylinder(hub_diameter / 2, hub_height)

# ---- through hole in each boss ----
for i in range(6):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 6)
    px = boss_circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = boss_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    result = result - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(boss_hole_diameter / 2, hub_height)

# ---- chamfer top rim edges ----
top_face = result.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
result = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = result
part.name = "hub_with_six_bosses"
export_step(part, "output.step")

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((-leg_width/2, 0), (-leg_width/2, overall_height))

from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 58.7
length = 80.0
bore_diameter = 14.7
counterbore_diameter = 28.0
counterbore_depth = 40.0
slot_width = 8.0
slot_depth = 12.0
radial_hole_diameter = 10.7
radial_hole_offset = 20.0
chamfer_size = 1.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2.0
counterbore_radius = counterbore_diameter / 2.0
radial_hole_radius = radial_hole_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(outer_radius)
    extrude(amount=length)

solid_body = p.part

# Through bore
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, length/2) * Cylinder(bore_radius, length)

# Counterbore from bottom face
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, counterbore_depth/2) * Cylinder(counterbore_radius, counterbore_depth)

# Longitudinal slot
slot_box = Pos(0, outer_radius - slot_depth/2, length/2) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, length)
solid_body = solid_body - slot_box

# Radial holes at two axial stations
for z_pos in [radial_hole_offset, length - radial_hole_offset]:
    hole = Pos(0, outer_radius - radial_hole_radius, z_pos) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(radial_hole_radius, outer_diameter)
    solid_body = solid_body - hole

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- overall envelope (from drawing) ----
overall_height = 80.1      # Z extent
overall_width  = 80.1      # X extent
overall_depth  = 60.1      # Y extent

# ---- fin profile (XZ plane) ----
root_radius  = 40.0        # inner root radius
tip_radius   = overall_height / 2.0   # 40.05 -> outer envelope
lobe_count   = 8
lobe_angle   = 360.0 / lobe_count     # 45 deg

pts = []
for i in range(lobe_count):
    a_tip  = math.radians(i * lobe_angle)
    a_root = math.radians(i * lobe_angle + lobe_angle / 2.0)
    pts.append((tip_radius * math.cos(a_tip),  tip_radius * math.sin(a_tip)))
    pts.append((root_radius * math.cos(a_root), root_radius * math.sin(a_root)))

# ---- sweep the profile along Y ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=overall_depth)

solid_body = p.part

# ---- 4x counterbored holes on the front face ----
hole_pattern_radius = 12.5 / 2.0
for i in range(4):
    a = math.radians(i * 90.0)
    px = hole_pattern_radius * math.cos(a)
    pz = hole_pattern_radius * math.sin(a)
    # through hole  ⌀2.0
    solid_body -= Pos(px, overall_depth / 2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(1.0, overall_depth + 10)
    # counterbore  ⌀4.5  (depth 5.0 from front face)
    solid_body -= Pos(px, 2.5, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(2.25, 5.0)

part = solid_body
part.name = "fin_with_counterbored_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

base_hole_dia = 1.6            # 4x through base corners (along Y)

            # straight middle section

                          (-overall_width/2,  overall_length/2 - curve_len),
                          (-overall_width/2,  overall_length/2))
            # close through the end hole centres

from build123d import *
import math

gear_outer_radius = 40.0
gear_inner_radius = 26.5
gear_height = 23.6
tooth_count = 12
tooth_depth = 5.0
bore_radius = 10.0
chamfer_distance = 2.0

tooth_angle = 360.0 / tooth_count
tooth_width = 2 * gear_outer_radius * math.sin(math.radians(tooth_angle / 2)) * 0.6

result = Cylinder(gear_outer_radius, gear_height)

for i in range(tooth_count):
    angle = i * tooth_angle
    tooth = Rot(0, 0, angle) * Pos(gear_outer_radius - tooth_depth / 2, 0, 0) * Box(tooth_width, tooth_depth, gear_height)
    result = result - tooth

result = result - Cylinder(bore_radius, gear_height)

bottom_face = result.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
bottom_edges = bottom_face.edges()
result = chamfer(bottom_edges, chamfer_distance)

part = result
part.name = "gear"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 80.0
inner_diameter = 53.0
height = 23.6
knurl_depth = 2.0
knurl_width = 4.0
knurl_count = 12
thread_diameter = 16.0
chamfer_size = 0.8

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(outer_radius)
    extrude(amount=height)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_size)

# Central through hole
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, height/2) * Cylinder(thread_diameter/2, height)

# Internal thread (approximated as a bore)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, height/2) * Cylinder(inner_radius, height)

# External knurl cuts
for i in range(knurl_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / knurl_count)
    px = (outer_radius - knurl_depth/2) * math.cos(angle)
    py = (outer_radius - knurl_depth/2) * math.sin(angle)
    cut = Pos(px, py, height/2) * Rot(0, 0, math.degrees(angle)) * Box(knurl_depth, knurl_width, height)
    solid_body = solid_body - cut

part = solid_body
part.name = "knurled_bushing"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
overall_height = 76.4          # vertical extent of the web
overall_width  = 40.0          # width of the web (front-to-back)
web_thickness  = 7.3           # thickness of the vertical web
flange_length  = 40.0          # length of each horizontal flange
flange_thick   = 7.3           # thickness of each flange
hole_diameter  = 3.6           # through hole in the web
hole_radius    = hole_diameter / 2.0
chamfer_size   = 0.5           # small chamfer on the top edges

# ---- vertical web (centred in Y and Z) ----
web = Box(web_thickness, overall_width, overall_height)

# ---- top flange ----
top_flange = Pos(web_thickness/2 + flange_length/2, 0,
                 overall_height/2 - flange_thick/2) * \
            Box(flange_length, flange_thick, flange_thick)

# ---- bottom flange ----
bottom_flange = Pos(web_thickness/2 + flange_length/2, 0,
                    -overall_height/2 + flange_thick/2) * \
            Box(flange_length, flange_thick, flange_thick)

# ---- assemble the C-section ----
part = web + top_flange + bottom_flange

# ---- through hole in the web (axis along Y) ----
hole = Pos(0, 0, overall_height/2 - flange_thick - 10) * \
       Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_radius, overall_width + 10)
part = part - hole

# ---- chamfer the top edges ----
top_edges = part.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
part = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

part.name = "C_section"
export_step(part, "output.step")

base_width = 80.0
base_thickness = 12.8

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
overall_width = 80.0          # across the semicircular base
thickness = 12.8              # part thickness (extrusion depth)
arc_radius = overall_width / 2.0   # 40.0
stem_width = 20.0
stem_height = 30.0
stem_top_radius = stem_width / 2.0  # 10.0
hole_diameter = 4.8          # 1x hole through the stem (side view)
hole_center_y = stem_height + stem_top_radius / 2.0   # 40.0 from base
chamfer_size = 0.3

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            # semicircular base (flat side up, bulge down)
            ThreePointArc((-arc_radius, 0), (0, -arc_radius), (arc_radius, 0))
            # right side up to stem
            Line((arc_radius, 0), (stem_width / 2.0, 0))
            # stem up
            Line((stem_width / 2.0, 0), (stem_width / 2.0, stem_height))
            # rounded stem top
            ThreePointArc((stem_width / 2.0, stem_height),
                          (0, stem_height + stem_top_radius),
                          (-stem_width / 2.0, stem_height))
            # left side down to arc start
            Line((-stem_width / 2.0, stem_height), (-arc_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# ---- through hole in the stem (drilled from the side, along Y) ----
hole = Pos(0, hole_center_y, thickness / 2.0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2.0, 200)
solid_body = solid_body - hole

# ---- small chamfer on all edges ----
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "semicircular_base_with_stem"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---- Shaft profile (from SECTION A-A) ----
shaft_total_length = 80.0
base_height = 15.0
step1_height = 30.0          # knurled grip section
step2_height = 10.0          # reduced neck
step3_height = 12.0          # top boss
# diameters -> radii
r_grip = 14.1                # ø28.2 knurled grip
r_neck = 10.25               # ø20.5 neck
r_boss = 7.7                 # ø15.4 top boss
r_tip = 2.95                 # ø5.9 tip (not used as profile point)

with BuildPart() as p_shaft:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (r_grip, 0), (r_grip, base_height),
                     (r_grip, base_height + step1_height),
                     (r_neck, base_height + step1_height),
                     (r_neck, base_height + step1_height + step2_height),
                     (r_boss, base_height + step1_height + step2_height),
                     (r_boss, shaft_total_length), (0, shaft_total_length), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

shaft = p_shaft.part

# ---- Knurl teeth (annular rings around grip) ----
knurl_pitch = 2.0
knurl_count = int(step1_height / knurl_pitch)
knurl_radius = r_grip + 0.5
knurl_z_start = base_height + knurl_pitch / 2.0

knurl = None
for i in range(knurl_count):
    z = knurl_z_start + i * knurl_pitch
    ring = Pos(0, 0, z + knurl_pitch / 2.0) * Cylinder(knurl_radius, knurl_pitch)
    knurl = ring if knurl is None else knurl + ring

shaft_knurled = shaft + knurl

block_height = base_height
mount_hole_dia = 7.7
mount_hole_offset = 11.2

hole = Pos(-block_width / 2 + mount_hole_offset, 0, block_height / 2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_dia / 2, block_depth + 10)

part.name = "knurled_shaft_with_base"

        with BuildLine() as bl:

                          (leg_thickness, overall_width/2 - inner_radius))
            # top leg outer side
            Line((leg_thickness, overall_width/2 - inner_radius),
                 (leg_thickness, -overall_width/2 + inner_radius))

tube2 = dict(outer=16.4, bore=12.3, length=40.0, x=0.0,   z=12.0)

# ---- Tubes (cylinders along Y, centred at Y=0) ----
def make_tube(t):
    outer = Pos(t["x"], t["length"]/2, t["z"]) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(t["outer"]/2, t["length"])
    bore  = Pos(t["x"], t["length"]/2, t["z"]) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(t["bore"]/2,  t["length"])
    return outer - bore

tube3_s = make_tube(tube3)

import math

# ---- dimensions from drawing ----
outer_radius = 40.0          # printed 40.0  (centerline radius of the band)
band_thickness = 12.0        # radial thickness of the curved band
inner_radius = outer_radius - band_thickness   # 28.0
band_height = 17.9           # printed 17.9  (axial height)
fillet_radius = 0.5          # small rounded edges (no printed size)
slot_width = 2.0             # narrow slots (no printed size)
slot_depth = band_thickness + 2.0
slot_angles = [30.0, 90.0, 150.0]   # three slots across the half-round

# ---- half-round curved band (revolve 180 deg about Z) ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, -band_height/2), (outer_radius, -band_height/2))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius + band_thickness/2, 0))   # outer notch
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (outer_radius, band_height/2))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, band_height/2))
            l5 = Line(l4@1, (inner_radius - band_thickness/2, 0))   # inner notch
            l6 = Line(l5@1, (inner_radius, -band_height/2))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z, revolution_arc=180.0)

solid_body = p.part

    rad = math.radians(ang)
    cx = outer_radius * math.cos(rad)
    cy = outer_radius * math.sin(rad)
    slot = Pos(cx, cy, 0) * Rot(0, 0, ang) * Box(slot_depth, slot_width, band_height)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot

part.name = "half_round_band_with_slots"

import math

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
thickness = 5.5                 # plate thickness

lobe_offset = 20.0              # lobe centres offset from part centre

lobe2 = Pos(lobe_offset, 0, 0) * Cylinder(lobe_radius, thickness)
